name: Neal's Yard Remedies
description: UK natural and organic skincare, body care and aromatherapy brand that promotes an affiliate program on its own website, run through Awin.

evidence.summary: The brand's own affiliate page (fetched) invites publishers to 'earn up to 8%' commission, states the program is managed through Awin, and publishes the program contact affiliates@nealsyardremedies.com. The page makes no statement about a cap on total earnings, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

The brand's Awin US program profile, as surfaced in search, splits the rate at 6% for existing customers and 8% for new customers with a 30-day cookie and roughly $90 average order value. The base (existing-customer) rate of 6% is recorded, with the new-customer 8% documented here. No creator-count or cohort-size figure is published, so saturation is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Long-established organic skincare and wellness brand whose products fit skincare-routine and clean-beauty creator content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A public affiliate program promoted on the brand's own site; no dedicated creator-content program details are published.
reasons.compensation: 6% base commission (existing customers) rising to 8% for new customers, 30-day cookie; no published cap statement, so the cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: A named program email, affiliates@nealsyardremedies.com, is published on the brand's own affiliate page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open through Awin from the brand's own affiliate page.
reasons.credibility: Major UK high-street and online natural beauty brand with decades of trading history.

name: Lola's Lashes
description: UK false lash brand running a Refersion referral partner programme whose terms require affiliates to post monthly social content tagging the brand.

evidence.summary: The brand's own affiliate programme terms (fetched) govern its 'Referral Partner Programme': registration runs on its Refersion portal (lolaslashes.refersion.com) and partners earn a Referral Fee of 10% of the net value of each referred product purchase (excluding VAT and shipping), paid by bank transfer or PayPal within 30 days of a valid invoice. The terms contain no statement capping total earnings, so the cap is recorded as unknown; no creator-count figure is published, so saturation is recorded as unknown.

The same terms impose explicit creator-content obligations: affiliates must post on social media at least once per month (Story or in-feed), tag @lolaslashesofficial on the photo and in the caption, use #lolaslashes, and follow the brand, with removal for non-compliance - direct evidence the program is built on ongoing creator content.

reasons.niche_fit: False lashes fit makeup and beauty creator content directly.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program contractually requires monthly tagged social posts from every affiliate - unusually direct creator-content evidence from the brand's own terms.
reasons.compensation: 10% of the net product value per referred purchase, published in the brand's own terms; no cap statement appears in the terms, so the cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Registration is via the brand's Refersion portal; no direct program email is published in the terms.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open registration on the Refersion portal for adults able to receive PayPal payments.
reasons.credibility: Trading UK lash brand with full published programme terms; smaller than the category's global leaders.
